pillars.name: Security & Governance

findings.message: No secrets scanning configuration found

remediation.description:
Add gitleaks or truffleHog for secrets scanning in CI.

.gitleaks.toml config:
```toml
[allowlist]
description = "Global allowlist"
paths = ["node_modules", "vendor", "__fixtures__"]
```

GitHub Actions workflow (.github/workflows/gitleaks.yml):
```yaml
name: gitleaks
on: [push, pull_request]
jobs:
  scan:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with: { fetch-depth: 0 }
      - uses: gitleaks/gitleaks-action@v2
        env: { GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }} }
```

evidence.finding: AI assistants hardcode credentials at 2x the human rate — secrets scanning is critical to catch AI-introduced credential leaks before they reach production

findings.message: No license compliance tooling found in CI workflows

remediation.description:
Add license-checker, FOSSA, license-finder, or licensee to CI for automated license compliance checks.

GitHub Actions workflow (.github/workflows/license-check.yml):
```yaml
name: license-check
on: [push, pull_request]
jobs:
  check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: npx license-checker --production --failOn 'GPL-3.0;AGPL-3.0'
```

evidence.finding: AI agents copy code from training data without license awareness — automated license checking prevents accidental license violations in AI-generated code
